issue.title: Show negative amounts in red in XLSX exports
issue.body:
When we open an XLSX export, the first thing our controllers do is reformat the
Amount column so that negative amounts are red, the way every other workbook in
the office looks. Could the XLSX export do that itself? We don't need anything
similar in the CSV export.

input.title: Show negative amounts in red in XLSX exports
input.body:
File: src/export/xlsx.ts

Change amountFormat so the number format has a negative section that renders red, e.g. "#,##0.00;[Red]-#,##0.00" (and "#,##0;[Red]-#,##0" for zero-decimal currencies). Amounts stay numeric; only the cell format changes. The CSV writer is untouched.
